provenance.quote: An endoscope adapted to insert a treatment tool, the endoscope comprising:
an opening from which the treatment tool protrudes, the opening being provided on a distal end of the endoscope
a rotary shaft rotatably mounted in the opening
a raise base that is attachable to the rotary shaft and detachable from the rotary shaft in a predetermined attaching/detaching direction through the opening
a pair of engagement sections made of an elastic material
the rotary shaft includes an engagement surface extending in the attaching/detaching direction and abutting an inner surface of the engagement section
a projection configured to project toward a direction intersecting with the attaching/detaching direction
the projection is a convex portion protruding from the engagement surface toward the engagement section to be engaged
a recessed portion provided on an inner side with respect to a direction in which the engagement sections are opposed to each other
an attaching/detaching-direction display marker configured to indicate the attaching/detaching direction
a rotation preventing unit configured to prevent the raise base and the rotary shaft from relatively rotating
a groove formed on one of the raise base and the rotary shaft
a projection formed on an other of the raise base and the rotary shaft
an ultrasound transducer provided on a distal end
an elastic member provided around the rotary shaft
an operating unit configured to receive an operation for rotating the rotary shaft
a wire provided along the longitudinal direction, the wire having a proximal end connected to the operation unit
the rotary shaft includes a shaft section that is perpendicular to the longitudinal direction
a wire connection section connected to the distal end of the wire
the raise base being configured to rise around the rotary shaft while being attached to the rotary shaft
the pair of engagement sections extending in the attaching/detaching direction and opposing to each other with the rotary shaft interposed therebetween
the rotary shaft includes an engagement surface extending in the attaching/detaching direction and abutting an inner surface of the engagement section
